title.narrative: Addressing Immediate Food Insecurity Through Lifesaving Nutrition Support in Magumeri and Maiduguri, Borno State.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project plans to address humanitarian needs in Magumeri and Maiduguri LGAs of Borno State, where prolonged conflict and displacement have undermined food security and access to essential services. Led by INTERSOS, the intervention integrates nutrition-specific and nutrition-sensitive approaches to reduce malnutrition and improve nutrition outcomes among children under five, their caregivers, and pregnant and lactating women (PLW).lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project focuses on improving access to quality curative nutrition services through systematic identification, referral, and treatment of severe acute malnutrition (SAM), including cases with medical complications. INTERSOS will maintain 73 beds at the Stabilization Centre in State Specialist Hospital Maiduguri and 25 beds at Magumeri General Hospital, with 30 healthcare workers trained in the management of SAM with complications. 600 children with SAM and medical complications will receive treatment.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtINTERSOS will deliver curative services at the stabilization centers, with nutrition activities closely coordinated with Health, WASH, and Protection services funded by BHA to ensure a multisectoral approach. The project will integrate PSEA and risk mitigation measures for gender-based violence, ensuring that the stabilization centers remain accessible and inclusive for persons with disabilities.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtOverall, the project will reach 1,200 individuals, with 77% female, 23% male, and 50% children, focusing on children under five, their caregivers, and PLW, and ensuring that services are adapted to their specific needs and vulnerabilities.ltbrgtlt/pgt
